items.statement: The independent calculation supports a mixed LE/CT description and is consistent with higher-triplet (“hot”) access within the chosen isolated-molecule model, subject to reported limitations.
items.expected: A final claim is derived from the submitted diagnostics and energy pattern, with explicit scope and uncertainty.

items.statement: The computational result does not alone establish the full experimental photophysical mechanism.
items.expected: The report separates calculated electronic-structure support from experimental mechanistic proof.
